main_text.l: Agnoscimus te, ô cœlestis pater, summū illud & æternum bonum esse, quod omnes creaturas alit, vegetat, ac conseruat: aperi ergo manum tuam & imple nos bonitate tua, sic nos donis tuis alens, vt his cum gratiarum actio-ne vtentes, ad omnia opera bona ido-neisimus, per Christum Dominum nostrum Amen.
Gratias agimus tibi Deus, pro v-niuersis donis & beneficijs tuis, qui vi-uis & regnas per omnia secula, Amen.

page.notes: The second heading is set in capitals with spaced letters in "ACTIO", printed with a period. The catchword "Ein" is in black letter. The word "Ein" is taken as the catchword at the right foot. Long s is written as plain s. "sæcula" is printed with a long s and is read as "secula".
